# Handwritten PHCN forms, generated by a GAN

20 rehabilitation follow-up forms (27/BV1-P3), every handwritten field drawn
by **WriteViT** in the style of a real VNOnDB writer, with exact ground truth
beside each document.

This is the final deliverable of the internship. The measurement it supports
is in `docs/notion_final_report.md`, sections 7.6 to 7.8.

## Why it exists

Every earlier handwriting figure in this project was measured on specimens
written with a handwriting **font**. A font redraws each letter identically
everywhere, which is not what handwriting does. This set replaces the font
with a generative model trained on real Vietnamese handwriting, so that the
earlier numbers can be checked against something closer to reality.

The answer was that they were far too optimistic: Chandra reads **95.3%** of
the handwritten fields on the font version and **57.6%** here, a drop of
**37.7 points**.

## What is paired with what

Each document reuses the ground truth of its font-rendered twin in
`handwriting/generated`. Same patient, same techniques, same layout. Only the
handwriting differs. That pairing is what makes the 37.7 points attributable
to the handwriting rather than to the content.

| | font version | this set |
|---|---|---|
| folder | `handwriting/generated` | `handwriting_gan/generated` |
| handwriting | Playwrite VN font | WriteViT, 20 real writers |
| documents | 30 | 20 |

## Layout

```
generated/
└── specimen_XXX/
    ├── specimen_XXX.png         the document, as it would be photographed
    ├── specimen_XXX.pdf         the same, vector
    ├── specimen_XXX.tex         the LaTeX source that produced it
    ├── specimen_XXX_verite.json ground truth + the writer id used
    └── mots/                    one PNG per generated word
```

## Reading the ground truth

`_verite.json` records **what is actually drawn**, not the source text. Two
consequences worth knowing before scoring against it.

**Punctuation is absent.** WriteViT's alphabet has neither space nor
punctuation, so punctuation splits words instead of being deleted: `12/07` is
drawn as `12` then `07`, never as `1207`. Removing the slash would fabricate a
number that was never written, and the ground truth would then lie about the
image.

**Digits are not GAN output.** The generator never learned to form digits
(report section 7.7), so words containing a digit fall back to the handwriting
font at 0.55 scale. They are about 14% of the word occurrences on a page, and
they are read under the easy regime, which means the true cost of real
handwriting is **larger** than 37.7 points, not smaller.

`scripteur` in each file is the VNOnDB writer index used for that document.
One writer per document, because a real sheet is filled in by one person.

## Rebuilding it

Needs the WriteViT checkpoint and `xelatex` on the PATH.

```bash
python scripts/remplir_gan.py --depot-writevit ../WriteViT --n 20
```

Packing it for Kaggle (the archive is not versioned, see `.gitignore`):

```bash
cd handwriting_gan && zip -r ../documents_gan.zip generated -x "*/mots/*"
```

## Results on this set

`results/documents_gan_chandra/` holds the Chandra run: raw output per page,
per-field scores, and `report.html` for a visual written-versus-read
comparison. The plate used in the report is
`demo/figures/21_lecture_documents_gan.png`.
